image_description: A dark-colored plastic rain barrel positioned outdoors against the siding of a building. A white flexible downspout diverter connects the roof gutter to the top inlet of the barrel. The barrel shows signs of weathering with white residue on its side. An orange hose or cable is visible near the base. The setting includes a paved walkway and a chain-link fence in the background.
